text: Being here feels like wandering at the edge of creativity and inquiry. The glass-walled room invites contemplation, almost sterile in its formality, yet ripe with the potential for ideas to be exchanged. Moving toward the vibrant R+D wall, I feel inspired—a burst of color and purpose, celebrating research and development. I sense excitement, as if I am amidst the birth of new projects, surrounded by the possibility of discovery and innovation.
